extracted.name: Cocktail Wieners
extracted.description: These cocktail weenies are made in a slow cooker for a sweet-savory snack with 3 easy ingredients: smoked sausages, BBQ sauce, and grape jelly.
ingredient_lines: 2 (16 ounce) packages cocktail sausages (such as Lit'l Smokies®)
instruction_lines: Mix barbeque sauce and grape jelly in a slow cooker; add cocktail sausages and stir until well coated.
Cover and cook on Low for 2 to 3 hours.
